items.stem: In the Next.js App Router, components are by default rendered where?

options.rationale: Correct: App Router components are server components unless opted into the client.
Client-only is opt-in, not the default.

options.rationale: Server rendering is the default behaviour.

items.stem: Which TWO are good reasons to mark a component as a client component? (Select TWO.)

options.text: It uses state or effects for interactivity
options.rationale: Correct: hooks like useState/useEffect require a client component.

options.rationale: Secrets belong on the server, not the client.

items.stem: How do you keep cached server data fresh in Next.js?

options.text: Configure revalidation for the fetch or route
options.rationale: Correct: revalidation refreshes cached data on a schedule or on demand.
Disabling the server does not manage caching.

options.text: Move every fetch to the client
options.rationale: Client fetching bypasses but does not solve server caching strategy.

options.text: Hardcode the data in the bundle
